name: Hermes Agent
overview: Hermes 是按缓存 epoch 冻结提示词、以 provider usage 锚定增量估算、用多入口 gate 触发事务式工作集替换的系统。廉价 prune、默认关闭的 rolling micro、批量摘要、Codex-owned native 各有不同所有权；原始会话保留用于恢复，活动 prompt 只是一个投影。

layers.name: stable system tier
layers.lifecycle: 一个缓存epoch保持字节稳定；pinned skill按agent首次解析后复用
layers.budget: context文件另有动态字符cap；不是总窗口保障

layers.name: project context tier
layers.lifecycle: 组装时位于stable后、volatile前；不是每轮重读
layers.budget: context文件默认动态cap=max(20K,min(window×4×0.06,500K))字符，显式context_file_max_chars优先

layers.name: volatile system tier
layers.lifecycle: volatile指重建时更可能变化；会话中仍冻结，压缩后invalidate重新装配
layers.budget: 占输入不可随消息摘要消失；存储/插件可各有限制，不能当成免费token

layers.name: tool schema floor
layers.lifecycle: 正常每次请求携带，工具能力列表保持稳定
layers.budget: 计入prompt压力；system+schema可成为不可压缩floor

layers.name: active messages
layers.lifecycle: 正常追加；压缩候选替换活动序列
layers.budget: usage anchor + appended delta；无usage时启用明确heuristic

layers.name: loaded skill bodies / subdirectory hints
layers.source: skill_view结果、slash user消息、文件工具结果上的子目录规则提示
layers.lifecycle: 进入历史而非改写system；被压缩后须显式reload
layers.budget: 占tool/user历史；SKILL_PRUNED标记指出正文已失

layers.name: head / summary / tail projection
layers.lifecycle: head额外早期消息仅首次受保护；摘要替代middle；尾部可有stub
layers.budget: lean默认clamp(2.5%W,10K,25K)再受20%W cap；摘要单独预算

layers.name: durable original transcript + archive
layers.lifecycle: 活动行软归档，保留可恢复证据；并发tail重排至新projection后
layers.budget: 存储长度不受模型窗口同一上限约束

rules.title: 缓存epoch内冻结system，而非每轮刷新记忆
rules.action: 按stable→context→volatile组装；invalidate后reload memory与plugin snapshot
rules.loss: 压缩前新写memory不会立即重进system
rules.gate: 显式invalidate / 新epoch

rules.title: context文件按字符cap，不是总token上限
rules.action: 显式cap优先，否则window×4×6%，clamp到20K..500K字符
rules.preserve: 项目指导前缀；截断警告显式输出
rules.loss: 超出cap正文不进入prompt
rules.gate: skip_context_files可跳过

rules.title: loaded skill失去正文后必须reload
rules.condition: 历史skill_view / slash inline body被裁剪或摘要
rules.action: 加入SKILL_PRUNED与skill_view(name=...)恢复提示；重置读去重缓存
rules.loss: 正文不再模型可见；摘要不能替代执行指导
rules.gate: 系统预加载skill位于stable，语义不同

evidence.symbol: # A committed prune is a content-loss boundary

rules.title: usage anchor绑定整个已计价prefix
rules.action: 保存prompt+completion、base_count、最后消息fp和base_prefix_fp
rules.preserve: 已确认用量锚点，可跨DB重读与进程重启
rules.loss: 不是新请求精确token计数；tools/system独立变更需各处失效机制
rules.gate: 只有整个已计价message prefix仍匹配才复用

rules.title: 只估算锚点之后的新增delta
rules.action: total=prompt_tokens+completion_tokens+rough(new appended messages)，跳过已计入completion的首个assistant
rules.preserve: 实际prefix计数避免全量字符估算偏高
rules.loss: 追加delta仍是粗估；reasoning计价与实际context可能不同
rules.gate: 无效锚点返回None

rules.title: 无anchor的粗估过线可先等一次provider证据
rules.condition: first request / rewind / edit-resend / 压缩后且rough>=threshold
rules.action: threshold gate推迟一次；usage-less provider不再无限等
rules.preserve: 不因膨胀粗估立即有损压缩
rules.loss: 可能先遭一次真实超限拒绝
rules.gate: 真实overflow总有reactive path；anchor figures不defer

rules.title: 先算有效比例，再扣输出与floor/cap
rules.action: p=global或longest substring/provider scope override；W<512000时p>=.75；B=W-R(若<=0退W)；T=max(floor(Bp),64000)，floor绑定时cap到85%B，最终还有显式cap与aux ceiling
rules.preserve: 输出余量、小模型可触发性
rules.loss: 不是固定50%；特定Codex route会再抬阈值
rules.gate: provider/model override和feasibility影响实际阈值

rules.title: 网关hygiene是更外层安全网
rules.condition: 入站history>=最小条件，compression enabled；usage或5000消息到线
rules.action: 默认85%W gate；actual→persisted anchor→rough；检查持久cooldown与in-flight
rules.loss: outer粗估仍可能提前
rules.gate: 配置可变hard limit，非agent50%比例

rules.title: turn-start、pre-API、post-tool都可压缩
rules.condition: 各entry point压力到阈值且attempt budget允许
rules.action: 统一调用_compress_context，重建后重启当前iteration而非继续发旧request
rules.loss: 不能声称只在用户turn末才检查
rules.gate: cooldown/structural/no-progress/ownership gates

rules.title: proactive prune默认关闭且有收益门槛
rules.action: 确定性去重/缩短旧tool result bodies、退休旧图像；至少回收4096估算token才提交。tool_call arguments作为canonical execution records不改写；它们仅在送摘要模型的序列化副本中限长
rules.preserve: 尾部、最后完整重复副本、明确stub与archive
rules.loss: 非尾部大tool result细节与旧图像会失去模型当前可见性；执行参数原记录不改
rules.gate: 该独立prune不等同full compress的必经phase1

rules.title: full compress phase1先裁剪候选副本
rules.action: 复制canonical用于abort/no-op；对副本_prune_old_tool_results后选中段
rules.preserve: abort可返回canonical；调用参数full流程不改写
rules.loss: 成功candidate里的旧结果可能已变stub
rules.gate: 不需要启用proactive trigger

rules.title: 早期head保护会衰减
rules.condition: 首次压缩前 vs 已compression_count>=1/previous_summary/重启读到summary
rules.action: system若存在始终单独保护；protect_first_n额外行首次后降为0
rules.loss: 最初用户轮不永久原样存活
rules.gate: 恢复的早期handoff也触发衰减

rules.title: lean尾部为预算目标，20条不是硬承诺
rules.action: budget=max(10K,min(25K,floor(.025W)))，再min(.20W)；walk soft ceiling=min(1.5budget,.20W)
rules.preserve: 最新row、必要user/assistant与原子工具组
rules.loss: 可舍弃较老optional rows；实际tail可超预算
rules.gate: count floor在可满足空行开销时甚至floorless，保证中段可压

rules.title: legacy与lean不能混同
rules.action: tail budget=threshold_tokens×target_ratio，再受20%W cap
rules.loss: 更多token持续占窗口
rules.gate: lean不按target_ratio算tail

rules.title: 原子tool group与最新行不能切断
rules.condition: 候选cut落在tool结果组或最新row过大
rules.action: backward/forward align保留完整assistant(tool_calls)+tool results
rules.loss: 单组过大会使预算无法严格满足
rules.gate: 最后sanitize还移除孤立结果/修复孤立调用

rules.title: 超大单轮允许有界拆分，但非任意删除最新请求
rules.condition: 文本opening user正常大小，后续tool growth使整轮超soft ceiling
rules.action: 保留组对齐mid-turn cut，opening request进入handoff并verbatim restate；图片/音频opening不可此替换
rules.preserve: 最新用户语义与最新tool组
rules.loss: 旧单轮中段被摘要
rules.gate: single oversized user本身不可拆；min_tail_user_messages>1承诺优先预算

rules.title: 摘要输入本身先有损限流
rules.action: 每body总6000字符(head4000/tail1500)、args1500字符；aggregate160K字符，整段均匀sample记录覆盖而非多模型分块
rules.preserve: 全时段抽样覆盖、精确标识符和省略说明
rules.loss: 模型从未看到被裁/采样掉的正文
rules.gate: retry/main fallback是失败重试，不是常规chunk summary

rules.title: 摘要输出预算与tail独立
rules.action: summaryBudget=max(2000,min(.20M,min(.05W,10000)))；还受aux/output room处理
rules.loss: 模型摘要有损，无召回保证
rules.gate: 模型返回length判失败，不当完整摘要

rules.title: lean尾部旧工具结果可降成恢复stub
rules.condition: 结果>1500chars且早于最新6个tool rounds
rules.action: 一行说明+session_search(session_id)；skill正文损失附SKILL_PRUNED
rules.loss: tail保留不等于tool正文永远保留
rules.gate: required pending / skill markers按专门规则保护

rules.title: 候选生成与持久发布是不同阶段
rules.action: 在session compression lease内生成candidate，校验progress与snapshot；cancel fence赢则不写；watermark/CAS写事务
rules.loss: 只有成功提交后活动窗口替换
rules.gate: legacy rotation另分支；lease-less prune/micro有CAS gate

rules.title: 摘要期间新消息必须留在新工作集尾部
rules.action: archive只覆盖held范围，concurrent tail重新排到compacted projection后
rules.preserve: 所有未被摘要worker看到的新用户/工具到达
rules.loss: 不把迟到输入悄悄归档
rules.gate: coverage/holder/held_for_cas验证；旧generation writer拒绝

rules.title: micro是默认关闭的辅助LLM rolling summary
rules.action: finalize后每N次吸收一个head-tail之间完整exchange，更新rolling summary；达到defrag门槛再压summary
rules.loss: 该exchange正文转入rolling marker
rules.gate: 只strict True built-in callable，watermark不可回答则skip

rules.title: 压缩是否有效只由后续真实usage裁决
rules.condition: 压缩后第一份真实provider计数仍>=threshold
rules.action: ineffective strike+1；连续2次自动breaker；低于线清零
rules.preserve: 防system+schema不可压缩floor引起每轮循环
rules.loss: breaker可能留上下文仍高压，须显式处理
rules.gate: static fallback streak不触发此breaker，它改为bench failing summary model

rules.title: 失败不应统称丢middle或全部保留
rules.condition: 辅助summary失败，distinct model可先一次main fallback
rules.action: network/auth/quota/empty/truncated等终态保canonical；timeout/truncation60→300→900 cooldown；JSON/closed/empty30s；持续overload3次可降deterministic
rules.preserve: 原文在abort保留，fallback含旧summary快照与可抽取anchors
rules.loss: fallback不保证决策/活动状态召回，显式标Unknown
rules.default: abort_on_summary_failure=false不代表所有错误都丢原文
rules.gate: force可清cooldown；真实overflow只bypass cooldown不清状态

rules.title: provider-proven overflow有界恢复
rules.action: 计attempt，bypass_cooldown=True压缩重建；耗尽/timeout不重复送同样超限请求
rules.loss: 无法保证所有输入都可压缩进窗口
rules.gate: lock/transient defer退还attempt，不误报exhaustion

rules.title: Codex-owned thread必须让Codex压缩
rules.action: compact_thread()操控权威线程；Hermes本地transcript保持不变
rules.loss: Hermes自己摘要mirror无法节省Codex线程token
rules.default: auto_compaction native默认；hermes由Hermes gate initiate；off跳自动
rules.gate: force manual可发；checkpoint_required此route拒绝，因为无真实pre-boundary

rules.title: native opaque checkpoint不按密文字符定价
rules.action: note_native_compaction_checkpoint打开await-real-usage latch，清旧rough baseline
rules.loss: 本地看似0或密文很长都不代表真实token
rules.gate: 与Codex app-server本地mirror不变不同

pipeline.outputs: 冻结的三段system + 稳定tool schema
idle/preflight compressed history 或原工作集
允许发送 / 压缩后重启iteration / defer失败

pipeline.inputs: 有界middle + previous summary + memory context

pipeline.outputs: role合法、工具配对、actionable task恢复后的candidate
原行软归档、新active投影与并发tail，system重建

scenarios.name: 普通lean压缩：从缓存epoch到新的工作集
scenarios.assumptions: W=200000，max_tokens=20000，非Codex特例、无绝对/aux cap、有效p=.75，阈值135000；示例账本起170000。proactive prune与micro都未启用；phase1 prune仍在full compress内发生。
